llm.summary: This appears to be a legitimate n8n automation harness, but it can change live workflows and credentials and includes an under-disclosed runtime npm install/auto-hook path that deserves review before use.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent with the artifacts: it helps agents create, deploy, activate, run, debug, and resync n8n workflows. Those are high-impact capabilities, but they are central to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The router broadly applies to n8n-related requests and some helpers activate workflows by default, so users should be clear when they want read-only inspection versus live changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Registry metadata says there is no install spec or required binary, while the docs and helper code use pip, optional plugin hooks, and a runtime npm install of an n8n SDK. The npm install is purpose-related but under-disclosed and modifies the installed helper area.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill reads per-environment workspace files and .env secrets and talks to the configured n8n instance. This is expected for deployment/debugging, but users should treat the workspace as sensitive.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill documents workspace memory and, in plugin mode, an asynchronous post-tool auto-tidy hook. Both are disclosed and scoped, but they create persistent/automatic behavior users should understand.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable giving an agent deployment-level access to your n8n environment. Start in a dev/staging n8n instance, use least-privilege API keys, review auto-tidy/plugin behavior, and verify or preinstall the npm dependency used for workflow layout before relying on it in production.
llm.findings: [suspicious.exposed_secret_literal] expected: The provided snippet is `--env-vars apiKey=[REDACTED],url=OPENROUTER_BASE_URL`, which looks like documentation for a provider API key placeholder rather than an exposed real secret in the supplied evidence.

evidence.explanation: The tidy helper can fetch and install a Node package at runtime into the helpers directory. This is related to the workflow-layout purpose, but it is not reflected in the registry install requirements and may run through the documented auto-tidy path.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Before using plugin/auto-tidy mode, review the npm dependency, consider preinstalling/pinning it yourself, and run the skill in a workspace where modifying helper/node_modules is acceptable.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Using tidy features may download and run third-party npm code on the user’s machine, even though the registry presents the skill as having no install spec or required binaries.

evidence.explanation: Plugin mode adds automatic post-tool behavior that can modify workflow template files asynchronously. It is disclosed and scoped to template JSON files, but it is still persistent automatic behavior.
evidence.snippet: Auto-tidy hook — a `PostToolUse` hook fires after every Write/Edit/MultiEdit tool call; the hook script filters to `*.template.json` files and runs `tidy_workflow.py --in-place`

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use plugin mode only if you want automatic template rewriting; otherwise disable or remove the hook as described in the install notes.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Template files may be changed automatically after edits, and the agent may briefly see untidied content because the hook is asynchronous.

evidence.explanation: The deploy helper can update and activate workflows in the configured n8n instance. This is expected for a deployment harness, but it is a live external mutation.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use separate dev/staging/prod environments, review workflow keys and env names before deploy, and use `--no-activate` when you want deployment without making triggers live.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A mistaken deploy can change or activate real automations, which could affect business processes or send data through connected services.

evidence.explanation: The skill expects a powerful n8n API key, including credential scopes. That access is purpose-aligned, but sensitive and broader than a read-only integration.
evidence.snippet: An n8n instance the agent can reach via REST + an API key with workflow + credential scopes

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Provide the least-privileged n8n API key possible, prefer non-production environments for testing, and store `.env.<env>` files securely.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may be able to create, update, activate, or inspect n8n resources using the supplied API key.

evidence.explanation: The skill intentionally persists project memory in a workspace file and reuses it across sessions. This supports continuity but can carry stale or poisoned instructions if the file is edited unexpectedly.
evidence.snippet: read `N8N-WORKSPACE-MEMORY.md` in the workspace at the start of every session; append a dated entry whenever you learn something durable about this project

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review `N8N-WORKSPACE-MEMORY.md` periodically, keep secrets out of it, and treat changes to that file like changes to project configuration.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Incorrect or malicious content in the workspace memory file could influence future agent behavior for the project.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill has expected live workflow-mutation powers, plus a more concerning under-disclosed runtime npm install path and automatic plugin hook behavior.

permission_boundary.summary: The skill requires powerful n8n API access, including workflow and credential scopes, which is expected but sensitive.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: Workspace memory is intentionally persisted and reused, so users should keep it accurate and free of secrets.
